correctness.rationale: The convolution-derived two-sided density, its exact positive derivative representation, Tonelli moment integration and Gamma duplication are reconstructed for \(a\ge b\ge0\), \(c=a+b>0\), including a=b and b=0 limits. The two positive constituent moment kernels have strictly positive second logarithmic derivative on every real \(s\ge2\) by a trigamma-series bound, and positive mixtures preserve strict log-convexity. A separately applicable published one-order Gaussian lower bound ensures a nonnegative boundary derivative after variance normalization; differentiation then yields strict Lp-to-Lq comparison. The packaged exact-arithmetic checker independently verifies density-integrated even moments against the mgf for 63 nonzero rational scale pairs and 10 even orders each, all normalized mass/variance cases, additional Gaussian inequalities, algebraic curvature inequalities and real-order numerical checks (2,647 assertions). Finite tests are supporting evidence, not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The arXiv:2602.03058v1 source explicitly leaves this two-exponent inequality and stronger normalized-moment log-convexity as conjectures. Its Gaussian-scale-mixture argument covers paired symmetric coefficients, not genuine asymmetric triples. A second closely related primary PDF treats different exponent regimes. Multiple targeted public mathematical-record and literature searches find no dominating theorem. value.rationale: The precise pairwise Gaussian norm inequality and stronger strict normalized-moment log-convexity are explicit motivating open directions for the 2026 source. Their full all-real-exponent \(n=3\) case extends the elementary symmetric two-term case to genuinely asymmetric sign patterns and uses a structural positive-Gamma representation, not numerical special cases or mere pointwise bounds. The result is a natural complete first asymmetric dimension and supplies a reusable proof technique for larger sign patterns, without falsely claiming \(n\ge4\).
